# delivery module responsibility map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-module-maps.mjs; DO NOT EDIT. -->

This file is derived only from `@responsibility` declarations in each source file header.

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `async-merge.ts` | Attaches PR auto-merge and confirms merges on the git plane. |
| `delivery-ci.ts` | Classifies card-level delivery-time CI truth from this card's own PR checks. |
| `evidence-gate.ts` | Gates pushes on freshly produced acceptance evidence for this cycle. |
| `gate.ts` | Prevents false delivered conclusions when main CI is red after merge. |
| `infra-default.ts` | Provides the default Node child-process implementation of the delivery ExecPort. |
| `lease.ts` | Consults the one-card-one-lease delivery claim before dispatch. |
| `pr-reconcile.ts` | Polls pending PRs into an updated local operator view. |
| `pr.ts` | Plans the publish-PR wait-merge-close delivery path as decisions and commands. |
| `rebuild.ts` | Rebuilds the deliveries projection cache from runs and git facts. |
| `reconcile-guards.ts` | Guards reconcile side effects with idempotency predicates. |
| `reconcile.ts` | Determines delivery truth from layered merge signals. |
| `required-check.ts` | Decides the required checks that gate self-merged delivery paths. |
| `state.ts` | Projects a cycle's delivery state from its event stream. |
| `store.ts` | Appends delivery records to the deliveries store atomically. |
| `tcr-observation.ts` | Folds TCR round observations into per-round telemetry and proof. |
| `tcr.ts` | Enforces the TCR test-and-commit freshness gate for every commit. |
| `test-runner-resolver.ts` | Resolves the deterministic per-commit test-gate command for the target project. |
